apps.localizedDescription: Read the Bible in several translations, search it, mark words, take notes, write documents and prepare Bible studies. Your data stays on your phone. Beta: the iPhone version is new, please report what does not work.

## New in 1.9.9
**Kind of update:** Feature, Bug fix
- **[Feature]** **Everything syncs:** besides marks and notes now also tasks, bookmarks, the reading list, prayer requests, headings, your own cross-references, studies, memory verses, vocabulary, the reading plan, categories, colors and saved searches.
- **[Feature]** **Changes show at once:** what another device synced appears on the home page, in the reading view and in the lists without restarting.
- **[Feature]** **Cloud folder:** sync through OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox or any shared folder; the devices need not be on at the same t

## New in 1.9.8
**Kind of update:** Feature, Bug fix
- **[Feature]** **Reading progress syncs too:** chapters read on one device show as read on the other; "unread" travels as well.
- **[Feature]** **Sync button:** "Sync" next to the version number at the bottom (PC) and at the top of the Tools menu (phone).
- **[Feature]** While both apps are open, devices sync every 20 seconds besides a few seconds after each change.
- **[Bug fix]** "Sync now" also reaches an iPhone (it never answers the network call-out).
- **[Bug fix]** Reading progress from another device was taken over only once per star

- **[Feature]** **Sync reminder:** after 3 days without a sync the app reminds you to open it on the other device. Nothing gets lost meanwhile: marks made apart on both devices all arrive on both.
